The AI reads documents for you and saves the typing: a photo or a PDF is enough, and the text turns into ready-made entries — deadlines and dates included. Nothing is ever created on its own: you see every suggestion and add it with one tap.

TASKS
Parent letters, notices from school or daycare, letters from authorities, invoices, appointment slips. Whatever has to be done becomes a task — a date found in the text becomes its due date, a looming penalty or reminder makes it high priority.

SHOPPING LISTS
Recipes become articles with quantity and category. You can change the number of servings before adding them, and every amount scales along. A handwritten note or a photographed label works just as well. Recognised ingredients can be kept as a favorite list under a name of your choice — together with their source: the link, or the photo respectively the PDF as a media object below "Rezeptfotos". "Open recipe" shows that original again later.

DATES
Whatever takes place instead of being done — a parents' evening, a course, an outing, a closing day — becomes an appointment in the calendar, with its time and multi-day periods. This needs the OpenCalendar module set up.

NOTES
Whatever is worth keeping without being a task or an appointment — access data, meter readings, reference numbers, opening hours, the gist of a long letter — becomes a note. It lands as a suggestion in the folder of the family member the mail belongs to, and its attachment can be kept along with it.

Privacy notice

popup.caption: Privacy notice for the AI features

items.caption:
WHAT IS TRANSMITTED

Each analysis transmits only what that analysis requires. For a photo or a PDF this is the file in question. For a recipe link, the website content read out for the analysis is transmitted.

The e-mail analysis processes the subject, the message text and, where present, one attachment as PDF or image.

These contents may include personal data, for example names, addresses, dates of birth or health information. Especially with documents and e-mails of other people, check whether you want to transmit these contents to the selected AI service.

WHO RECEIVES THE DATA

The analysis data is transmitted to the AI provider you have selected in this instance.

When using OpenAI or Anthropic, the data leaves your own network and is processed on the respective provider's infrastructure. Depending on provider, contract, account settings and selected region, processing may also take place outside the EU or the European Economic Area. The provider's respective API, privacy and data processing terms apply. For their commercial services, OpenAI and Anthropic offer data processing agreements or Data Processing Addenda.

If you use a fully locally operated AI server instead, the analysis data stays within your own network, provided that server does not itself forward data to external services.

If you use an external service such as Mailgun to receive e-mail, every e-mail sent to the address set up for it, including its attachments, is first processed by that service. With Mailgun, the infrastructure used depends, among other things, on the US or EU region selected for the account.

WHAT IS STORED

On this server, photos and PDFs submitted solely for AI analysis are not stored permanently. They are processed only for the duration of the respective request.

There are three exceptions, all of them below this instance and all of them removable at any time: the photo or PDF of a recipe kept as a favorite list (media object below "Rezeptfotos"); files you attach to a note yourself (media object below "Notizen"); and, if the option "Keep the attachment when a note is suggested" is switched on, the attachment of an e-mail from which a note was suggested. The latter is stored at the moment of the analysis — that is, also when the suggestion is discarded later or expires after 21 days. Files that no note and no current suggestion refers to any more are removed automatically. Note titles and note texts stay stored in this instance until you delete the note or its folder.

Independently of this, the selected AI provider may store inputs, outputs or technical log data for a limited period under its own terms. The actual retention period depends on provider, API, account type and the settings made there. With OpenAI, API content may by default be kept in safety logs for up to 30 days. Anthropic deletes API inputs and outputs by default within 30 days, unless an exception applies or a different agreement is in place.

Suggestions generated from e-mails, in particular sender, subject and the entries derived from them, remain stored in this instance for up to 21 days or until you dismiss them earlier.

E-mails received via the webhook are stored temporarily in a queue on this server until they have been processed. Processing normally takes place within a few seconds. Unprocessed messages are deleted after 7 days at the latest.

The message log stores sender and subject of an analysed e-mail, but not the actual message text.

Accepted tasks and entries remain stored in your lists. Accepted appointments are additionally transmitted to the calendar connected via OpenCalendar and are thus also processed by your respective calendar provider.

If you save a recipe as a favorite, the associated photo or PDF remains stored as a media object below "Rezeptfotos" until the corresponding entry or list is deleted.

API keys are stored exclusively in this instance's configuration on your server. They are not transmitted to the apps.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITY

You decide which contents are analysed and which external services are used for it.

For exclusively personal or family use, the so-called household exemption of the GDPR may apply. If, however, the use goes beyond this purely personal or family sphere, the GDPR's requirements may apply in full.

Insofar as you are responsible for a processing operation under data protection law, you must in particular check whether personal data may be transmitted to external services and which contractual or data protection requirements this entails. This may also concern data processing agreements and rules on international data transfers.

This applies especially to data of other people and to specially protected data, for example health data.

The developer of this module does not receive any analysis content through the use of the module, operates no processing servers for it and is not involved in the transmission to the services you have selected.

You can deactivate the AI analysis and the acceptance of e-mails at any time. Messages in the local queue that have not yet been processed are discarded in the process.

This notice describes the module's technical data processing. It does not replace individual legal or data protection advice.

REQUIREMENTS AND COSTS
Your own API key is required. Anthropic and OpenAI charge a few cents per analysis and receive the photo, the PDF or the recipe text. A local server (e.g. Ollama) keeps everything inside your network, but needs a vision-capable model — and one that accepts documents if you want to analyse PDFs.
